integrity: Explicit normalization, all node regimes, and all bounded holomorphic matrix entries are covered; numeric diagnostics supplement rather than replace proof.
scientific_limitations: Two-dimensional complex matrices and equal positive swapped nilpotent targets only; no higher-size or asymmetric-target result. Full-matrix uniqueness is analytically proved, but independent validation and exhaustive bibliographic coverage are unavailable. Earlier unit-amplitude extremal existence is explicitly credited.
title: Unique extremal numerical-radius interpolation for swapped nilpotent targets
